voice.name: Sylvain - International english
voice.why: A relaxed middle-aged Frenchman speaking English: an evening stroller on the square.

greet.text: Evening. Lovely night for it, isn't it? Half the town is out on the square.

about_what.text: Nothing much, and that is the point. A drink, the band if they turn up, somebody's uncle telling the same story about the war.

about_where.text: The cafe is on the square, the bank across from it. For anything official, the town hall clerk. For anything unofficial, nobody saw me say a word.

replies.where: Where can I find things around here?
